The '''Tarnab''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] species characterized by their triangular skull. They possessed a snout and a cluster of horns amid rough hair. They were represented by [[Mot-Not Rab/Legends|Mot-Not Rab]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].
